title: The review-time evaluation of a kit disposition decision: one contract for the kit export and the evidence harness
status: Reviewer requirement adopted by the coordinator (2026-11-11, KDEC-051); every default here is PROPOSED for the owner.

original_record.rule: The decision object a kit run exported is the ORIGINAL record. A reader never changes its dates and never re-decides it: effective_decision stays what the kit evaluated on evaluated_on. A review adds a SEPARATE evaluation with its own date; both are kept.

review_evaluation.applies_when: effective_decision is APPROVED_EFFECTIVE; any other decision is NOT_AN_EFFECTIVE_APPROVAL at review (nothing to re-check, nothing upgraded)

expiry.rule: expires is a real date on or after the review date; a missing or unreadable date is EXPIRY_NOT_ESTABLISHED, never unexpired

revocation.rule: a revocation on or before the review date fails; with no revocation source the check is not established

scope.rule: the decision's scanner and rule equal the finding's, and its scope_path equals or matches (glob) the finding's path

approver_authority.rule: the approver held the authority the review policy names; the kit export carries no approver, so not established unless a review source says

separation_of_duties.rule: the approver is not the requester or the author; the kit writes NOT_ESTABLISHED, so not established unless a review source names both

review_states.rule: the first failing check in check_order names the state; else any check not established gives REVIEW_NOT_ESTABLISHED with the checks named; EFFECTIVE_AT_REVIEW only when every check passes

staleness.rule: a REVIEW POLICY, never an expiry: an evaluation older than the policy's days before the review date is flagged; it never changes the decision or the review state

key_basis.rule: a legacy-keyed record is always labelled and never gains approval authority through compatibility parsing: its review state is never EFFECTIVE_AT_REVIEW (re-key it to the durable identity). The legacy window's closing date lives in ONE kit constant, scripts/scan_report.py legacy_key_window_days (closes derived); this contract does not restate it.
